files_changed.summary: Rung 1: Highlight -> QuadPoints -> convertToViewportRectangle, quads flattened into one region with several normalized rects (g1).
The exact-text intersect (normalizeTextBoxes + intersectText) shared by rungs 1 and 2 (g1/g2).
HSV highlighter mask, connected components with the spec's minimums, line-box merge (g2/g3).
annotationCandidates / flattenedCandidates / scanCandidates — the three rungs, rung 3 reusing 011's cropped OCR (g1/g2/g3).
Derived review rows, none selected, below-gate flagged; accept writes selected rows as group highlights in one call (g4/g5).
The review screen: per-region checkbox + editable text + Import N regions (g4).
Added writeRows: N rows and their N outbox ops in ONE Dexie transaction (F5).
Widened NewHighlight with an optional layer (group import) and added insertHighlights (one batch transaction) (g5).
4 tests: multi-quad flatten, non-highlight ignored, rect fallback, rotation.
4 tests: reading-order join, no overlap, two lines, normalization.
4 tests: HSV bands, connected box, speck dropped, line merge.
3 tests: rung 1 exact/no-OCR, rung 2 mask+exact text, rung 3 crop+confidence.
4 tests: none selected, nothing unaccepted commits, one batch call with group rows, edited text written.
2 tests: 40 rows + 40 outbox ops in ONE transaction; empty import is a no-op.

decisions: The three rungs are pure functions (annotation-quads, colour-mask, text-in-region) composed by import-ladder; only rung 3 touches the async OCR seam, and it is 011's cropped recognizeRegion. rung 1 and rung 2 never import OCR, so 'exact text and zero OCR calls' is structural.

Rung 1 flattens every 8-number quad into one rect and keeps them in ONE region — a multi-line annotation is one focus point, not several. A malformed/no-QuadPoints annotation falls back to its own rect rather than being dropped.
Exact text is intersected in page-normalized space: pdfjs text boxes and region rects must share a space (RULE-17), so normalizeTextBoxes is applied first.

The colour mask is a pure module now; spec §5.4 suggests a Worker, which is a perf move, not a behaviour change (analyze.json NEW-1). The mask thresholds and the <8px-tall/<20px-wide drop and the >60% line merge are the spec's values.

group highlights: NewHighlight gained an optional layer, defaulting to individual; the import passes layer='group'. RULE-04 is enforced by RLS (a member's import would park), and the review screen is the leader's.

The review screen derives its rows from candidates with the reviewer's overrides in state (no seed effect) — the lint rule react-hooks/set-state-in-effect rejected the effect form, and the derived form is simpler.
F5's client half is one writeRows transaction; the server fan-out is 001's trigger and 007's channel, untouched.
The stored bbox colour stays null (resolved at render, as in 010/011); imported rects use tool 'rect'.
